boundary_audit.method: Compare previous-month 23:00 UTC and new-month 00:00 UTC hourly values for every archived month boundary, and count valid antecedent hours. A fixed-detector counterfactual compares continuous records with month-local runs; no missing values are imputed.

month_reset_detector_comparison.interpretation: Counterfactual month-reset audit at the fixed detector settings. A disagreement is boundary-sensitive detector behavior, not proof of a real event or absence.

calibration_holdout.assessment: This is a future-proof partition proposal only. Counts do not imply sufficient independent, well-observed, labeled target events for holdout verification; the current archive lacks independent causal labels and operational forecasts.
calibration_holdout.split_rule: Assign complete 72-hour-separated episode groups before splitting; groups touching the split seam are excluded from both partitions.

coverage_audit.note: Hourly missing intervals cover months with a generated hourly denominator. Retrieval errors, empty successful queries, and not-queried sources remain separate manifest states.

datum_transition_audit.detector_segmentation_rule: Detector series are partitioned at datum changes. No first-difference signal or antecedent baseline crosses a datum boundary; post-boundary onset is left-censored until sufficient same-datum baseline is available.

detector.MCHL1_role: supporting propagation observations only; no predeclared matching lead window and no causal classification.
detector.method: positive consecutive hourly change; fixed preceding 72-hour baseline; at least 48 valid one-hour changes; minimum 3-hour rise; minimum station-specific rise; sigma 2.0 primary; 6-hour reset; no interpolation.
detector.target_variable: MAUL1 native 00065 stage; gage height, not NAVD88.

independence.coverage_screen_rule: A detected target group is coverage-qualified when its target detector had at least 48 valid 72-hour baseline changes and all three core predictor windows (72 h DENL1; 18 h NWCL1/MDLL1) have the stated fraction of valid hourly rows. This is an observation-sufficiency screen, not evidence of true event independence or skill.
independence.known_dependence: Named Sally and Beta 2020 event windows are retained in their existing shared independence group; priority case names are not used as ground-truth labels.
independence.rule: Transitive grouping of overlapping active episode intervals and intervals separated by no more than 72 hours, across all five observation stations. This is a conservative time-separation heuristic, not a claim of scientifically independent storm events.

limitations: Historical time clusters are not independent storm labels; a 72-hour separation rule can join distinct forcing or split one prolonged episode.
MAUL1 00065 is native gage height and is not used to infer 4.0 ft NAVD88 exceedances.
A first-signal match is a retrospective timing association, not evidence of actionable warning, propagation, causality, or forecast skill.
Positive NWCL1 residual alone is not coastal evidence; independent MDLL1 and wind context are shown without an unvalidated wind threshold.
No DENL1 rise does not exclude tributary/local runoff; no independent event ground truth or issue-time data is available.
Retrieval errors, successful empty queries, and periods with partial hourly coverage remain explicit; missing observations are not filled.
